notes: Digital Intake scans no longer create directories or move loose media. Explicit Prepare or Queue creates a safe folder for a loose file.
Content hashes and validated folder identity replace mtimes in adoption identity; generated sidecars do not create false new jobs.
Adoption retries enqueue missing transfers after Mover availability changes and explicitly retry failed/cancelled transfers. Adds direct folder queueing without scanning unrelated Intake items.
Adds regressions for disabled-then-enabled Mover, read-only discovery, mtime changes, content changes, direct folder queueing and failed transfer retry.
